ios.desc:
Discover hiking trails, track the 100 Cims challenge and keep a record of every summit you reach. Cims helps you find your next hike, record your walks and share mountain adventures with friends.

100 CIMS AND SUMMIT CHALLENGES
Find the essential peaks, log your ascents and follow your progress across different mountain challenges. Explore summits in Catalonia and across Europe, unlock achievements and take part in the rankings.

MAPS, TRAILS AND WALK RECORDING
Find peaks and trails on the map, check difficulty and discover nearby places. Record your walks with distance, elevation gain and time, then export your tracks as GPX files.

MULTI-DAY TREKS
Discover routes with multiple stages and track your trek one stage at a time.

VIA FERRATAS, CANYONING AND CLIMBING
Explore the free via ferrata, canyoning and climbing catalogues. Check available details, difficulty grades, photos and locations. Save places you want to visit and log the activities you complete.

PLAN HIKES TOGETHER
Organise mountain outings, invite other people and chat with your group. Find your plans in the calendar and share photos, comments and tips.

YOUR MOUNTAIN LOGBOOK
Keep your ascents and activities together with photos, notes and ratings. Remember who joined you, including your dog, and look back on your adventures.

OPTIONAL CIMS PRO
Via ferrata, canyoning and climbing catalogues are free. Cims Pro adds private and featured outings, extra photo slots, summit-history downloads as CSV and assisted imports of your records. Your subscription also supports the project.

Monthly and annual subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled. The annual plan is billed upfront for the full year. Manage your subscription in your store account's subscription settings. Prices and billing terms are shown before purchase.

Privacy: https://fescims.com/privacy-policy
Terms: https://fescims.com/terms-of-service

Download Cims and choose your next hike.
